archetypeNotes: Gates + alternate-win, built spell-only outside its lands. Every nonland card is an instant or sorcery, so the deck conforms cleanly to Codie's "you can't cast permanent spells" restriction — the Gates are lands and are unaffected. 12 Gate-typed lands plus Maze's End give a compact alt-win; Approach of the Second Sun is a second. 10 cheap spells act as cascade fuel so Codie's exile-until-lesser-MV reliably hits.
curatorRationale: Optimized casual on structural grounds rather than staple density (0 premium tutors, 0 fast mana): total commitment to a non-obvious commander restriction across all 93 slots, plus two independent compact win conditions. Retained partly as a rater-ambiguity probe — 21 Gates and no creatures may be hard to place. NOTE: an earlier curator pass wrongly described this deck as having an internal construction tension between the commander and the Gates package; that reading was incorrect and is not carried forward.
